paragraphs.text: Erne is an obsolete creature type for a race of large birds of prey known for aquatic hunting of fish . They are also known as sea eagles.

Erne originally debuted as a type in Ice Age on Silver Erne . Arna Kennerüd claimed to see an Erne knock a Giant to the ground while staying airborne due to them moving as the wind instead of with the wind. During the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was made obsolete and given errata to just be a Bird.
